sentences.en: My mind is as bright and clean as a stainless mirror.
sentences.zh: 我的思想就像一面光洁无瑕的镜子。

sentences.en: Metal spoons are generally made of stainless steel.
sentences.zh: 通常，金属勺是由不锈钢制成的。

sentences.en: Most kitchen sinks are made of stainless steel.
sentences.zh: 大多数厨房水槽都是用不锈钢制成的。

senses.zh: 不锈的；不锈钢制的; 无污点的,无瑕疵的
